lines: Your robots.txt lets ChatGPT in. Your server might still slam the door.
Your hosting can still answer AI crawlers with a four oh three error.
Test it like the bot: send a request with GPTBot's user agent and look for a two hundred.
If AI can't read your page, it can't cite it.
Then check whether AI names your brand with SupaIntent.
profile: American female, about 40, marketing lead explaining one sharp finding to a peer. Dry, deadpan wit with a smile in the voice, confident, lively, ~185 WPM, close-mic.
music: Instrumental only, no vocals. Clean electronic tech groove: crisp hi-hats, deep sub bass, glassy synth arps, slightly tense then resolving, 115 BPM, 30 seconds.
